include(sources.cmake)
include(definitions.cmake)
file(MAKE_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/include")
configure_file(src/config.h.generic "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/include/config.h" COPYONLY)
configure_file(src/pcre2.h.generic "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/include/pcre2.h" COPYONLY)
configure_file(src/pcre2_chartables.c.dist "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/pcre2_chartables.c" COPYONLY)
add_library(abc_regex STATIC ${ABC_REGEX_SOURCES} "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/pcre2_chartables.c")
set_target_properties(abc_regex PROPERTIES C_STANDARD 99 C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
target_include_directories(abc_regex PUBLIC "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/include" PRIVATE src)
target_compile_definitions(abc_regex PRIVATE ${ABC_REGEX_DEFINITIONS})
if(MSVC)
    target_compile_definitions(abc_regex PRIVATE _CRT_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS)
endif()
